title: Public Hospitals with Dedicated Role Similar to Patient Care Officer
what_it_is: Public Hospitals with Dedicated Role Similar to Patient Care Officer

sections.label: Patient Care Officer roles in hospitals
sections.summary: Asks how many public hospitals have a role like the Patient Care Officer at Khoo Teck Puat Hospital and whether more such roles are planned.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) how many public hospitals have a dedicated role similar to the Patient Care Officer (PCO) position at Khoo Teck Puat Hospital; and (b) whether there are plans to encourage hospitals to have more roles similar to the PCO position.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They may just have different job titles, such as Care Support Associates or Patient Service Associates.

sections.label: Patient support roles and job redesign
sections.summary: States patient support roles exist but have practical limits, and the Ministry of Health is discussing job redesign with the clusters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I appreciate the Member's concern about the nurses having to undertake many different roles.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That is the whole point of creating these patient support roles, which are in the current hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But there are practical limits to actually extending this, because there are issues with truncating job roles into just purely clinical or non-clinical roles.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: These patient support roles can be very unattractive and then you end up not actually attracting anyone.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, every job has to bring satisfaction and purpose and we have to look at this holistically.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because of that, the Ministry of Health is already in discussions with the clusters to look at job redesign.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With regard to the ANGEL scheme, this is something that we can take into consideration and we can update Members in due course.
